corrections.ben_ruling: Ben, 2026-09-04. Asked whether to keep the ability to catch a clause filed in the wrong family, he ruled yes. The full-set digest keeps the discarded entries verifiable: a re-run reproduces the complete array and must match the stored digest.
discarded_per_effect: the per-profile entry for a profile that did NOT match: its predicate_result_digest and decisive_leaf_ids
preserved_explicitly: the contract continues to recompute the FULL profile set in validateEffectProfileMatches
all_family_profile_results is still built from that full recompute
compatible_cross_family_match_count keeps its real value; the NO_OUTPUT gate requiring it to be zero can still refuse
FAMILY_CORRECTION_PENDING can still be raised from profile evidence
the occurrence family remains an OUTPUT of matching, never read from the M4 claim
corrections.rationale: The committed corpus is dominated by non-match entries: every occurrence stores one row per profile, and about 99 per cent of them record that the profile did not match. Retaining every family's matches plus a digest of the complete array removes that bulk without removing the evidence that a clause matched a family other than its own.
retained_per_effect: every profile_result whose matched is true, from EVERY family, not only the occurrence own family
one sha256 digest of the complete canonical profile_results array, so a re-run can prove nothing was lost

size_basis.measured: 1.8 GB across ten analyses with every entry retained; 118-307 MB per analysis, verified live in A-0022.
size_basis.target: Under 200 MB committed. NOT measured for this shape. A-0022 item 19 stated 200 MB as an instruction to the external agent, and the per-agreement sizes requested for Q-0025 have not arrived.
